newsitem.title: UK: Rank shares gain after in-line results.
newsitem.headline: Rank shares gain after in-line results.

text.p: Shares in Rank Group Plc nudged higher in pre-market trade on Thursday after the leisure group posted annual profits in line with expectations coupled with a modestly upbeat statement.
The stock, under pressure in recent months, was up 8-1/2p at 423-1/2 by 0805 GMT.
Profit before tax of 297 million stg compared with analyst expectations mostly in a range between 283 million stg and 330 million stg.
"The steps were have taken are already making the company more focused entrepreneurial and forward looking," said chief executive Andrew Teare.
"These changes, together with the benefits of our investment programme and the generally favourable economic climate provide a promising outlook for Rank."
Rank shares have been under pressure since last June when the company warned that profits in its film and television divisions were being held back and margins in the leisure division were lower.
They came under further pressure after a disappointing trading statement last December.
"These are OK results in what has really been a year of huge transition," said Jason Crisp, analyst at SocGen. "People will have higher expectations for next year."
Crisp also highlighted a substantial cash outflow from the business. "Obviously people will be looking closely at how the money is being spent," he said.
By 0841 GMT Rank shares were up 12p at 427.
